newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde 1,221 MW nuclear unit ramping up.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde 1,221 MW nuclear unit ramping up.

text.p: The 1,221 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Palo Verde nuclear plant near Phoenix, Ariz., is in the process of ramping back up to full power after being taken down to 60 percent overnight, a spokesman for the plant said Wednesday.
The unit, which was curtailed for work to repair re-heater tubes, should be back to full power by later Wednesday, he noted.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221 MW units were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service Co, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, is the majority owner and operator of the Palo Verde plant.
